title: Snowy Conditions
headline: Snowfall. Keep warm, watch your footing, and travel only if needed.
quick: Layer up and keep your head covered
Take smaller steps on icy paths
notification: Snow today. Dress warm and take it slow.

wear.top: Thermal layer, sweater, insulated waterproof coat

avoid: Walking with hands in pockets on ice
watchFor: Numbness or pale skin in fingers and toes
Chest pain when shoveling (stop and get help)

activity.bestTime: Late morning when paths are cleared

travel: Carry a blanket, flashlight, and charger
Brake gently and keep a long gap
home: Check heating and keep pipes warm

people.kids: Waterproof layers and short play sessions; warm up indoors between rounds.
people.elderly: Stay in; ask for help clearing paths to avoid falls.
people.pets: Wipe paws to remove salt and ice; limit time out.
people.commuters: Leave early and check transport updates.
people.athletes: Shorten sessions; use trail shoes and layer well.

rules.tip: Frostbite risk: cover all skin and limit time outside.
Blowing snow and wind chill: add a face cover.
Paths refreeze after dark. Watch for ice.

commonMistakes: Shoveling heavy snow without warming up
